newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES FIRMER IN FLUSH MARKET.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES FIRMER IN FLUSH MARKET.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed Tuesday's interbank session stronger against hard currencies on the back of surplus foreign funds, dealers said.
"It was a very quiet day. The market was full of money-- we had one or two importers but nothing big enough to take up all the surplus," a dealer commented.
"Overseas the U.S. dollar continued firm and this also pushed our unit up (on European currencies)," he added.

The Zimbabwe dollar ended the day at 10.7400/7600 against the U.S. money, up from 10.7450/7650 at Monday's close, and was also firmer on pound sterling at 17.9283/9724 compared to 18.0900/1350 the previous day.
Against the mark it edged up to 6.8648/8811 from 6.8736/8908 and was at 2.3032/3101 against South Africa's rand from 2.3170/3240.
